description: This file is part of the 'pip' package vendor's internal tools, specifically the '_parser.py' module for parsing TOML files. It defines functions and classes to parse TOML configuration files, handle different value types, manage parsing errors, and maintain parsing state.

classes.name: TOMLDecodeError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors encountered during TOML decoding.

classes.name: Flags
classes.description: Class managing flags (states) for parsed TOML keys and namespaces, used to track frozen and explicit nest flags.

classes.name: NestedDict
classes.description: Data structure class wrapping a nested dictionary, providing methods for creating nested objects and appending to lists.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: NamedTuple combining NestedDict and Flags to encapsulate parsing state.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] load(__fp: BinaryIO, *, parse_float: ParseFloat = float)
methods.description: Reads TOML from a binary file object and parses it into a Python dictionary.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] loads(__s: str, *, parse_float: ParseFloat = float)
methods.description: Parses a TOML-formatted string into a Python dictionary.

methods.name: Pos skip_chars(src: str, pos: Pos, chars: Iterable[str])
methods.description: Skips specified characters in source string starting from a given position.

methods.name: Pos skip_until( src: str, pos: Pos, expect: str, *, error_on: frozenset[str], error_on_eof: bool, )
methods.description: Skips in the source string until a specified character is found; used for comment and string parsing.

methods.name: Pos skip_comment(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Skips over a comment starting at a given position in the source string.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,Key] create_dict_rule(src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output)
methods.description: Handles parsing of dictionary (table) declarations in TOML, creating nested objects.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,Key] create_list_rule(src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output)
methods.description: Handles parsing of list (array) declarations in TOML, creating nested lists.

methods.name: Pos key_value_rule( src: str, pos: Pos, out: Output, header: Key, parse_float: ParseFloat )
methods.description: Parses key-value pairs and updates the nested data structure accordingly.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,Key,Any] parse_key_value_pair( src: str, pos: Pos, parse_float: ParseFloat )
methods.description: Extracts a key and value from the source string at the current position.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,Key] parse_key(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Parses a dotted key into a tuple representing the key path.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_key_part(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Parses a component of a key, could be bare, quoted literal, or quoted basic string.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_one_line_basic_str(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Parses a single-line basic string value in TOML.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,list] parse_array(src: str, pos: Pos, parse_float: ParseFloat)
methods.description: Parses an array of values enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,dict] parse_inline_table(src: str, pos: Pos, parse_float: ParseFloat)
methods.description: Parses an inline table (dictionary) from its string representation.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_basic_str_escape( src: str, pos: Pos, *, multiline: bool = False )
methods.description: Parses escape sequences within a basic string.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_basic_str_escape_multiline(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Parses escape sequences within a multiline basic string.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_hex_char(src: str, pos: Pos, hex_len: int)
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal Unicode codepoint escape sequence.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_literal_str(src: str, pos: Pos)
methods.description: Parses a literal string enclosed in apostrophes.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_multiline_str(src: str, pos: Pos, *, literal: bool)
methods.description: Parses multi-line strings, both literal and basic.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,str] parse_basic_str(src: str, pos: Pos, *, multiline: bool)
methods.description: Parses a basic string, handling escape sequences and termination.

methods.name: tuple[Pos,Any] parse_value( src: str, pos: Pos, parse_float: ParseFloat )
methods.description: Dispatches to the appropriate parser based on the current character for various TOML value types.

methods.name: TOMLDecodeError suffixed_err(src: str, pos: Pos, msg: str)
methods.description: Creates a detailed parse error with source coordinates.

methods.name: bool is_unicode_scalar_value(codepoint: int)
methods.description: Checks if a codepoint is a valid Unicode scalar value.

methods.name: ParseFloat make_safe_parse_float(parse_float: ParseFloat)
